About

Eight years in, still writing code every day.

I'm Victor Padovam, a senior software engineer and Flutter specialist based in Brazil, currently leading engineering for a product team of developers, interns and UX specialists. I own architecture decisions, hiring and delivery for the products I lead.

My focus is on modern digital products — responsive websites, business systems and mobile apps with clean architecture and maintainable code. I combine product thinking, UI implementation and backend development so a client can have one person responsible for the solution end to end.

Outside client work, I speak at Google Developer Group events across Brazil and hold a Computer Science certificate from Harvard University's CS50, alongside 30+ other courses and certifications.
